name: @pipeworx/mcp-clash-royale

tools.name: player
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — full profile for a player tag (#2PP…): trophies, level, arena, clan, card collection, battle stats, and league ranking.

tools.name: player_battles
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — recent battle log for a player tag: outcome, decks used, opponent, arena, and trophy change for each of the last ~25 battles.

tools.name: player_upcoming_chests
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — upcoming chest cycle for a player tag: chest type and position index for the next chests in queue.

tools.name: clan
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — full clan profile for a clan tag: name, description, type, score, member count, trophies required, and war trophies.

tools.name: clan_members
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — paginated member list for a clan tag: each member's name, role, trophies, last active, and donations. Supports limit/after/before cursors.

tools.name: clan_war_log
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — war log for a clan tag: past war seasons with participants, battles played, wins, and final standings. Supports limit/after/before cursors.

tools.name: clan_current_war
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — current war status for a clan tag: war state, collection-day and war-day results, participants, battles remaining, and standings.

tools.name: clan_search
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — search clans by name, locationId, min/max members, or min score. Returns matching clans with trophy counts and member totals.

tools.name: tournament
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — tournament details for a tournament tag: name, description, max capacity, creator, current members, status, and game mode.

tools.name: tournament_search
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — search open tournaments by name. Returns matching tournaments with capacity, current members, and start time.

tools.name: cards
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — complete list of all game cards: name, max level, elixir cost, rarity, type, arena, and icon URL.

tools.name: locations
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — full list of supported location IDs (countries + global) used by ranking endpoints such as rankings_clans and rankings_players.

tools.name: location
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — details for a single location by numeric ID: name, country code, and whether it is a country or a global region.

tools.name: rankings_clans
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — top-ranked clans for a location ID (numeric): clan name, tag, score, member count, and rank position. Use global ID for worldwide rankings.

tools.name: rankings_players
tools.description: Clash Royale official API — top-ranked players for a location ID (numeric): player name, tag, trophies, exp level, clan, and rank position. Use global ID for worldwide rankings.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-clash-royale forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the clash-royale pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
